cards.name: Electro 2099
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Any “Alchemax“ or “Sinister“ Villain Group
Setup: [Adapt].
Master Strike: Each player discards three cards then draws a card. [Adapt].
Fight: You may discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards. [Adapt].

cards.name: Epic Electro 2099
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Any “Alchemax“ or “Sinister“ Villain Group
Setup: [Adapt].
Master Strike: Each player discards four cards then draws a card. [Adapt].
Fight: You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card. [Adapt].

cards.name: Sandwoman 2099
cards.abilities:
Sandwoman 2099 gets +2[Attack] for each Villain in the city.
Master Strike: You may either recruit or attack this turn, but not both. [Adapt].
Fight: The next player may either recruit or attack in their next turn, but not both. [Adapt].

cards.name: Epic Sandwoman 2099
cards.abilities:
Sandwoman 2099 gets +3[Attack] for each Villain in the city.
Master Strike: You may either recruit or attack this turn, but not both. [Adapt].
Fight: The next player may either recruit or attack in their next turn, but not both. [Adapt].

cards.name: Vulture 2099
cards.abilities:
Vulture 2099 gets +[Attack] equal to the highest [Victory Points] value of any Villain in the Escape Pile, Rooftops, or Bridge.
Master Strike: If there are any Villains on the Rooftops or Birdge, one of them escapes and each player gains a Wound. [Adapt].
Fight: You may move a Villain to another city space. If another Villain is already there, swap them. [Adapt].

cards.name: Epic Vulture 2099
cards.abilities:
Vulture 2099 gets +[Attack] equal to the highest two [Victory Points] values among Villains in the Escape Pile, Rooftops, and Bridge.
Master Strike: If there are any Villains on the Rooftops or Birdge, each of them escapes and each player gains a Wound. [Adapt].
Fight: You may move a Villain to another city space. If another Villain is already there, swap them. [Adapt].

cards.name: Doctor Octopus 2099
cards.abilities:
Doctor Octopus 2099 gets +4[Attack] unless you played at least 8 cards or a Hero that costs 8 this turn.
Master Strike: Each player discards cards whose total cost is at least 8 (for that player) or gains a Wound. [Adapt].
Fight: You may gain a Hero from the HQ whose cost is at least 8. [Adapt].

cards.name: Epic Doctor Octopus 2099
cards.abilities:
Doctor Octopus 2099 gets +8[Attack] unless you played at least 8 cards or a Hero that costs 8 this turn.
Master Strike: Each player discards cards whose total cost is exactly 8 (for that player) or gains a Wound. [Adapt].
Fight: You get +4[Recruit], usable only to recruit a Hero that costs at least 8. [Adapt].

cards.name: Venom 2099
cards.abilities:
Venom 2099 gets -1[Attack] for each card you have that costs 2.
Master Strike: Each player KOs a card that costs 2 from their hand or discard pile or gains a Wound. [Adapt].
Fight: You may gain a Hero that costs 2 from the HQ or KO pile. [Adapt].

cards.name: Epic Venom 2099
cards.abilities:
Venom 2099 gets -1[Attack] for each card you have that costs 2.
Master Strike: Each player KOs a card that costs 2 from their hand or gains a Wound. [Adapt].
Fight: You may gain a Hero that costs 2 from the HQ or KO pile. [Adapt].

cards.name: Goblin 2099
cards.abilities:
Goblin 2099 gets -1[Attack] for each Bystander in your Victory Pile.
Master Strike: Each player puts a Bystander from their Victory Pile into the Escape Pile or gains a Wound. [Adapt].
Fight: Each villain in the city captures a Bystander. [Adapt].

cards.name: Epic Goblin 2099
cards.abilities:
Goblin 2099 gets -1[Attack] for each Bystander in your Victory Pile.
Master Strike: Each player puts two Bystanders from their Victory Pile into the Escape Pile or gains a Wound. [Adapt].
Fight: Each villain in the city captures a Bystander. [Adapt].

cards.name: Avatarr, CEO of Alchemax
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Alchemax Enforcers
Setup: Add an extra Hero to the Hero Deck. [Adapt].
Master Strike: Put the two highest-cost Heroes from the HQ into the Escape Pile. Then [Cyber-Mod][Ranged]: Each player gains a Wound. [Adapt].
Fight: Each other player puts a non-grey Hero from their hand or discard pile into the Escape Pile. [Adapt].

cards.name: Epic Avatarr
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Alchemax Enforcers
Setup: Add an extra Hero to the Hero Deck. [Adapt].
Master Strike: Put the three highest-cost Heroes from the HQ into the Escape Pile. Then [Cyber-Mod][Ranged]: Each player gains a Wound to the top of their deck. [Adapt].
Fight: Each other player puts a non-grey Hero from their hand into the Escape Pile. [Adapt].

cards.name: Fearmaster, VP of the Public Eye
cards.abilities:
Fearmaster gets +1[Attack] for each grey Hero you have.
Master Strike: Put the two lowest-cost Heroes from the HQ into the Escape Pile. Then [Cyber-Mod][Instinct]: Count the number of [Instinct] cards in the Escape Pile. Each player discards that many non-grey Heroes, then draws a card for each card they discarded this way. [Adapt].
Fight: Each other player discards 2 grey Heroes. [Adapt].

cards.name: Epic Fearmaster
cards.abilities:
Fearmaster gets +2[Attack] for each grey Hero you have.
Master Strike: Put the three lowest-cost Heroes from the HQ into the Escape Pile. Then [Cyber-Mod][Instinct]: Count the number of [Instinct] cards in the Escape Pile. Each player discards that many non-grey Heroes, then draws two cards. [Adapt].
Fight: Each other player discards 3 grey Heroes. [Adapt].

cards.name: John Herod, Executive VP
cards.abilities:
[Cyber-Mod][Covert][Covert]: John Herod gets +5[Attack].
Master Strike: Put the two rightmost Heroes from the HQ into the Escape Pile. Then [Cyber-Mod][Covert]: You may pay 5[Attack] this turn to “expose Fake Captain America.“ If you do, KO one of your Heroes. If you don't by the end of this turn, each player gains a Wound (after you draw your new hand.) [Adapt].
Fight: KO two of your Heroes. [Adapt].

cards.name: Epic John Herod
cards.abilities:
[Cyber-Mod][Covert][Covert]: John Herod gets +7[Attack].
Master Strike: Put the three rightmost Heroes from the HQ into the Escape Pile. Then [Cyber-Mod][Covert]: You may pay 7[Attack] this turn to “expose Fake Captain America.“ If you do, KO one of your Heroes. If you don't by the end of this turn, each player gains a Wound (after you draw your new hand.) [Adapt].
Fight: KO one of your Heroes. [Adapt].

cards.name: Tiger Wylde, General of Alchemax Elite
cards.abilities:
[Cyber-Mod][Strength]: Tiger Wylde gets +1[Attack] for each [Strength] card in the Escape Pile.
Master Strike: Put the two leftmost Heroes from the HQ into the Escape Pile. Then [Cyber-Mod][Tech]: Each player reveals a [Tech] card or discards a card. [Adapt].
Fight: Send a Hero from the Escape Pile [Undercover]. Then [Adapt].

cards.name: Epic Tiger Wylde
cards.abilities:
[Cyber-Mod][Strength]: Tiger Wylde gets +1[Attack] for each [Strength] card in the Escape Pile.
Master Strike: Put the three leftmost Heroes from the HQ into the Escape Pile. Then [Cyber-Mod][Tech]: Each player discards a card at random. [Adapt].
Fight: Send a Hero from the Escape Pile [Undercover]. Then [Adapt].

cards.name: Annihilus
cards.abilities:
[Mass Momentum 2]
Always Leads: Annihilation Wave (1 player: Use 6 Henchmen.)
Master Strike: Reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it's a Bystander, Annihilus captures it. If it's a Villain, it enters the city, captures a Bystander, and moves forward an extra space (before doing any Ambush ability).

cards.name: Epic Annihilus
cards.abilities:
[Mass Momentum 4]
Always Leads: Annihilation Wave. Add an extra Villain Group (even for 1 player.)
Master Strike: Play a card from the Villain Deck. If it's a Villain, play a second card from the Villain Deck.

cards.name: The Cosmic Control Rod
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals the top three cards of their deck, KOs the highest-cost Hero that is revealed this way and puts the rest back in any order.

cards.name: Surging Annihilation
cards.abilities: Fight: Check all Annihilation Wave villains from each other player's victory pile. The one worth the most VP enters the city, and that player rescues bystanders equal to that villain's VP.

cards.name: Deploy the Planet Killer
cards.abilities: Fight: If this is not the final tactic: if Weaponized Galactus is in the city, he escapes. If Weaponized Galactus wasn't in the city and wasn't in any victory pile, then he enters the city from the Villain Deck and you shuffle the Villain Deck.

cards.name: Pull Into the Negative Zone
cards.abilities: Fight: The cost of each hero currently in the HQ gets -2 this turn.

cards.name: Kang the Conqueror
cards.abilities:
Kang has [Conqueror 2] for each city space under a Time Incursion. (He benefits from Villains there.) Villains under a Time Incursion get +2[Attack].
Always Leads: Timelines of Kang
Master Strike: This Strike becomes a “Time Incursion.“ Put it above the rightmost city space that doesn't yet have a Time Incursion.

cards.name: Epic Kang the Conqueror
cards.abilities:
Kang has [Conqueror 3] for each city space under a Time Incursion. Villains under a Time Incursion get +3[Attack].
Always Leads: Timelines of Kang
Master Strike: This Strike becomes a “Time Incursion.“ Put it above the rightmost city space that doesn't yet have a Time Incursion. If there are any Villains in any Time Incursions, each player gains a Wound.

cards.name: Iron Lad Grows Up to Become Kang
cards.abilities: Fight: If this is not the final Tactic: Each player reveals their hand. You choose a card named “Iron Lad“ from the Escape Pile, or from [Man Out of Time], or from any player's hand or discard pile or that you played this turn. Shuffle Iron Lad into Kang's Tactics as a Mastermind Tactic that says “Fight: Gain this as a Hero.“

cards.name: Leap Into the Timestream
cards.abilities: Fight: If this is not the final Tactic: Take another turn after this one. Don't play a card from the Villain Deck at the start of that turn.

cards.name: Pull From the Future
cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal the top two cards of the Villain Deck. Choose a Villain revealed this way to enter an empty city space under a Time Incursion. Put the rest back in any order.

cards.name: Savior From Another Timeline
cards.abilities: Fight: You may gain a Hero from any HQ space under a Time Incurion. Send it as a [Man or Woman Out of Time].

cards.name: Morgan Le Fay
cards.abilities:
[Chivalrous Duel]
Always Leads: Queen's Vengeance
Master Strike: Each player in turn reveals a [Covert] Hero or gains a 0-cost Hero or Wound from the KO pile.

cards.name: Epic Morgan Le Fay
cards.abilities:
[Chivalrous Duel]
Always Leads: Queen's Vengeance
Master Strike: Each player in turn gains a Wound, then gains a 0-cost Hero from the KO pile.

cards.name: Reverse the Flow of Time
cards.abilities: Fight: For the rest of the game, players take turns in the opposite order around the table.

cards.name: Sorcerous Blasts
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player discards a [Covert] Hero or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Stolen Tomes of Merlin
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +4[Recruit] usable only for recruiting [Covert] and/or [Ranged] Heroes.

cards.name: Transmogrify
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player in turn KOs a non-grey Hero from their discard pile, then gains a card from the KO pile that has a lower cost.

cards.name: Ultron
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Ultron's Legacy
Master Strike: Each player reveals a [Tech] Hero or puts a non-grey Hero from their discard pile into a “Threat Analysis pile“ next to Ultron. Ultron is [Empowered] by each color in his Threat Analysis pile.

cards.name: Epic Ultron
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Ultron's Legacy
Master Strike: Each player puts a non-grey Hero from their hand into a “Threat Analysis pile“ next to Ultron. Ultron is [Triple Empowered] by each color in his Threat Analysis pile.

cards.name: Arrogant Blindspot
cards.abilities: Fight: You may gain a Hero from Ultron's Threat Analysis pile.

cards.name: Paralyzing Encephalo-Ray
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards each card that has the same card name as any card in Ultron's Threat Analysis pile.

cards.name: Predictive Analysis
cards.abilities: Fight: Put the top three cards of the Hero Deck into Ultron's Threat Analysis pile.

cards.name: Self-Repairing Legions
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player in turn reveals a [Tech] Hero or puts an Ultron's Legacy Villain from the Victory Pile into an empty city space.

cards.name: Killmonger
cards.abilities:
While Killmonger has more than 0[Attack], you cannot fight him. Instead, you may spend [Attack] equal to his [Attack] to [Wound him] and get +1[Recruit].
Always Leads: Killmonger's League
Master Strike: Each player must reveal 4 different Hero Classes or gain one of the [Wounds on Killmonger]. Any player who can't do either must discard down to 4 cards.

cards.name: Epic Killmonger
cards.abilities:
While Killmonger has more than 0[Attack], you cannot fight him. Instead, you may spend [Attack] equal to his [Attack] to [Wound him] and get +1[Recruit]. When you do fight him, each other player gains one of [his Wounds].
Always Leads: Killmonger's League
Master Strike: Each player gains a Wound. Gain them from [Killmonger's Wounds] if possible.

cards.name: A Scar for Every Kill
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +1[Recruit] for each non-Henchman Villain in your Victory Pile.

cards.name: Rite of Challenge
cards.abilities: Fight: Each player with no Killmonger Tactics in their Victory Pile gains a [Wound that was on Killmonger]. (You have this Tactic, so you won't gain a Wound.)

cards.name: Throw from the Waterfall
cards.abilities: Fight: Draw two cards. Then each other player discards a card.

cards.name: Altar of Resurrection
cards.abilities: Fight: The player on your left chooses a non-Henchman Villain from their Victory Pile. It enters the city with a [Wound on it]. Then the player on your right does the same effect. (In solo, you do both.)

cards.name: Klaw
cards.abilities:
Klaw is [Double Empowered] by the color(s) of his “Sonic Frequency“.
Always Leads: Enemies of Wakanda
Master Strike: Put the top card of the Hero Deck next to Klaw as a “Sonic Frequency,“ putting any previous Frequency on the bottom of the Hero Deck. Each player must reveal a card that shares a color with it or gain a Wound.

cards.name: Epic Klaw
cards.abilities:
Klaw is [Quadruple Empowered] by the color(s) of his “Sonic Frequency“.
Always Leads: Enemies of Wakanda
Master Strike: Put the top card of the Hero Deck next to Klaw as a “Sonic Frequency.“ Put any previous Frequency and each card from the HQ that does not share a color with the new Frequency on the bottom of the Hero Deck. Each player gains a Wound.

cards.name: Cohesive Sound Construct
cards.abilities: Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. This Tactic enters the city as a Villain whose only ability is “Escape: This card becomes a Master Strike that takes effect immediately.“

cards.name: Convert Matter to Sound
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player simultaneously KOs one of their non-grey Heroes. Put one of those cards with the lowest cost next to Klaw as his new Sonic Frequency. Put any previous Frequency on the bottom of the Hero Deck.

cards.name: Ultrasonic Boom
cards.abilities: Fight: Put the top card of the Hero Deck next to Klaw as a Sonic Frequency. Each other player must discard a card that shares a color with it. Put any previous Frequency on the bottom of the Hero Deck.

cards.name: Cruelty Provokes Resistance
cards.abilities: Fight: Set aside all Heroes from the HQ that do not share any colors with Klaw's Sonic Frequency. Gain one of them. Put the rest on the bottom of the Hero Deck. Then refill the empty HQ spaces.

cards.name: Taskmaster
cards.abilities:
Henchmen get +1[Attack] for each “Henchman Training“ stacked here.
During your turn, Taskmaster gets +[Attack] equal to the highest cost Hero you played this turn.
Always Leads: Taskmaster's Thunderbolts
Master Strike: Stack this Strike next to Taskmaster as “Henchman Training.“ If there are any Henchmen in the city, each player gains a Wound.

cards.name: Epic Taskmaster
cards.abilities:
Henchmen get +2[Attack] for each “Henchman Training“ stacked here.
During your turn, Taskmaster gets +[Attack] equal to double the highest cost Hero you played this turn.
Always Leads: Taskmaster's Thunderbolts
Master Strike: Stack this Strike next to Taskmaster as “Henchman Training.“ If there are any Henchmen in the city, each player gains a Wound.

cards.name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Initiative Trainer
cards.abilities:
Fight: Choose a Henchman from any player's Victory Pile to enter the city.
KO any number of S.H.I.E.L.D. Agents and/or Troopers. Gain that many S.H.I.E.L.D. Officers.

cards.name: Photographic Reflexes
cards.abilities:
Fight: Choose a Henchman from any player's Victory Pile to enter the city.
Play a copy of a Hero in the HQ that costs 6 or less.

cards.name: Teacher and Assassin
cards.abilities:
Fight: Choose a Henchman from any player's Victory Pile to enter the city.
Each other player reveals their hand and puts one of their non-grey Heroes on the bottom of the Hero Deck.

cards.name: Henchman Instructor
cards.abilities:
Fight: Choose a Henchman from any player's Victory Pile to enter the city.
Then each other player discards a card for each Henchman in the city and/or Escape Pile.

cards.name: Indestructible Man
cards.abilities:
You can't use [Attack] to fight Indestructible Man.
Once during each of your turns, you may shuffle two Elite Assassins from your Victory Pile into the Villain Deck. If you do, fight Indestructible Man.
Always Leads: Elite Assassins
Master Strike: Shuffle an Elite Assassin from your Victory Pile into the Villain Deck. If you can't, each player gains a Wound.

cards.name: Epic Indestructible Man
cards.abilities:
You can't use [Attack] to fight Indestructible Man.
Once during each of your turns, you may shuffle three Elite Assassins from your Victory Pile into the Villain Deck. If you do, fight Indestructible Man.
Always Leads: Elite Assassins
Master Strike: Each player shuffles an Elite Assassin from their Victory Pile into the Villain Deck. Each player that can't gains a Wound.

cards.name: Manipulate Murderous Mad Monk
cards.abilities:
Fight: If this is not the last Tactic, rescue four Bystanders and this Tactic enters the city as a “Molot Boga“ Villain whose abilities are:
“Ambush: Play two cards from the Villain Deck.
Fight: KO one of your Heroes.
Escape: Shuffle this back into Indestructible Man's Mastermind Tactics.“

cards.name: Secrets of Indestructibility
cards.abilities:
Fight: KO up to two Wounds from your hand and/or discard pile.
If this is not the last Tactic, play two cards from the Villain Deck.

cards.name: International Arms Dealer
cards.abilities:
Fight: Gain a [Tech] Hero from the HQ. Each other player reveals a [Tech] Hero or gains a Wound.
If this is not the last Tactic, play two cards from the Villain Deck.

cards.name: Unveil Project Four
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards each card with a “4“ printed anywhere on it. (The copyright date line doesn't count.)
If this is not the last Tactic, play two cards from the Villain Deck.

cards.name: Arnim Zola
cards.abilities:
[Ultimate Abomination]
Always Leads: Zola's Creations
Master Strike: For each Hero in the HQ that has less than 2 printed [Attack], put that Hero on the bottom of the Hero Deck, and each player discards a card of that Hero's cost.

cards.name: Dominate the Weak
cards.abilities: Fight: The player of your choice gains a Hero from the HQ that has less than 2 printed [Attack].

cards.name: Computer-Uploaded Genius
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Tech] Hero or discards a card.

cards.name: Pet Projects
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a Zola's Creations Villain from their Victory Pile or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Crush Pacifist Resistance
cards.abilities: Fight: KO up to two of your Heroes that have less than 2 printed [Attack].

cards.name: Baron Heinrich Zemo
cards.abilities:
Whenever you fight a Villain, you may use 2[Recruit] to rescue a Bystander. Baron Zemo gets +9[Attack] unless you are a [Savior].
Always Leads: Masters of Evil (WWII)
Master Strike: Each player KOs a Bystander from their Victory Pile. Any player who cannot do so gains a Wound.

cards.name: Fallen Idols
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player that is not a [Savior] discards a card.

cards.name: Finding Zemo
cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal the top five cards of the Villain Deck. If you revealed any Bystanders, KO them and each other player gains a Wound. Put the rest back in random order.

cards.name: Hatred for the Avengers
cards.abilities: Fight: For each of your [Avengers] Heroes, rescue a Bystander.

cards.name: Prisoners of War
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals an [Avengers] Hero or chooses a Bystander from their Victory Pile, and you rescue that Bystander.

cards.name: Fin Fang Foom
cards.abilities:
[Size-Changing]: [Strength],[Instinct],[Covert],[Tech],[Ranged]
Always Leads: Monsters Unleashed
Master Strike: [Demolish] each player, then do it again for each Monsters Unleashed Villain in the city and Escape Pile.

cards.name: Epic Fin Fang Foom
cards.abilities:
[Size-Changing]: [Strength],[Instinct],[Covert],[Tech],[Ranged]
Always Leads: Monsters Unleashed
Master Strike: [Demolish] each player, then do it again for each Monsters Unleashed Villain in the city and Escape Pile. KO all the Heroes [Demolished] this way.

cards.name: Alien Dragon Technology
cards.abilities: Fight: A Hero in the HQ gets [Size-Changing]: [Strength],[Instinct],[Covert],[Tech],[Ranged] this turn.

cards.name: Flammable Acid Breath
cards.abilities: Fight: KO the top card of the Hero Deck. Then each other player KOs a Hero of that Hero class from their discard pile ([Strength],[Instinct],[Covert],[Tech],[Ranged]).

cards.name: Multipronged Assault
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals at least 3 Hero Classes ([Strength],[Instinct],[Covert],[Tech],[Ranged]) or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Supersonic Dive Attack
cards.abilities: Fight: KO the top card of the Hero Deck. Then each other player reveals their hand and discards a Hero of that Hero Class ([Strength],[Instinct],[Covert],[Tech],[Ranged]).

cards.name: Pagliacci
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Wrecking Crew
Master Strike 1, 5: This card becomes a Scheme Twist that takes effect immediately.
Master Strike 2, 3, 4: [Demolish] each player.

cards.name: Epic Pagliacci
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Wrecking Crew
Master Strike 1, 3, 5: This card becomes a Scheme Twist that takes effect immediately.
Master Strike 2, 4: [Demolish] each player.

cards.name: Commedia Dell'Morte
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player may gain two Wounds. [Demolish] each of those players who does not.

cards.name: Creative Assassin
cards.abilities: Fight: You get [Versatile 3].

cards.name: Insane Clown Has a Posse
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player may KO a Wrecking Crew Villain from their Victory Pile. [Demolish] each of those players who does not.

cards.name: Jester of a Twisted Opera
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player may KO a card from their discard pile that costs 1 or more. [Demolish] each of those players who does not.

cards.name: Authoritarian Iron Man
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Superhuman Registration Act
Master Strike: Authoritarian Iron Man [fortifies] the next city space to his right, starting with the Bridge. You can't fight him while there's a Villain in that space. Villains in that space get +3[Attack].

cards.name: Armada of Armors
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +6[Recruit] usable only to recruit [Ranged] and/or [Tech] Heroes.

cards.name: Freeze Domestic Assets
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards all their cards with [Recruit] icons.

cards.name: Man the Fortifications
cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it's a Villain, it enters the city space that Authoritarian Iron Man is fortifying.

cards.name: Recall to Service
cards.abilities: Fight: The Villain with the highest printed [Attack] in the Escape Pile enters the city space that Authoritarian Iron Man is fortifying.

cards.name: Baron Helmut Zemo
cards.abilities:
Baron Zemo gets -1[Attack] for each Villain in your Victory Pile.
Always Leads: Thunderbolts
Master Strike: Each player KOs a Villain from their Victory Pile. Any player who cannot do so gains a Wound.

cards.name: Blasted Henchmen!
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Tech] Hero or KOs a Villain from their Victory Pile.

cards.name: Cursed Dynasty
cards.abilities: Fight: When you draw a new hand of cards at the end of this turn, draw two extra cards.

cards.name: Endless Minions
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Tech] Hero or chooses a Villain from their Victory Pile and it enters the city.

cards.name: Revenge for My Father
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand. Each player who revealed an [Avengers] Hero gains a Wound.

cards.name: Maria Hill, Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
cards.abilities:
[Double S.H.I.E.L.D. Clearance]. You can't fight Maria Hill while there are any S.H.I.E.L.D. Elite or Officers in the city.
Always Leads: S.H.I.E.L.D. Elite
Master Strike: Two S.H.I.E.L.D. Officers enter the city as 3[Attack] Villains. When you fight them, gain them as Heroes.

cards.name: Crash the Helicarrier
cards.abilities: Fight: KO any number of your [S.H.I.E.L.D.] Heroes.

cards.name: Declare Martial Law
cards.abilities: Fight: Put a S.H.I.E.L.D. Officer into each empty city space as 3[Attack] Villains. When you fight them, gain them as Heroes.

cards.name: Evacuation Code Epsilon
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards a [S.H.I.E.L.D.] card.

cards.name: Rapid Response Team
cards.abilities: Fight: Two S.H.I.E.L.D. Officers enter the city as 3[Attack] Villains. When you fight them, gain them as Heroes.

cards.name: Misty Knight
cards.abilities:
[Bribe]
Always Leads: Heroes for Hire
Master Strike: Each player reveals 4 cards with [Recruit] icons or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Bionic Repulsor Field
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Marvel Knights] Hero or puts two cards from their hand on top of the deck.

cards.name: Cyborg Detective
cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal the top three cards of the Villain Deck. Put them back in any order.

cards.name: Trusted Bodyguard
cards.abilities: Fight: Going clockwise, the first other player with Colleen Wing in their Victory Pile rescues 5 Bystanders and returns Colleen Wing to play [fortifying] Misty Knight.

cards.name: Vibranium Cyber Arm
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Marvel Knights] Hero or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Ragnarok
cards.abilities:
Ragnarok gets +2[Attack] for each Hero Class among Heroes in the HQ.
Always Leads: Registration Enforcers
Master Strike: Each player says “zero“ or “not zero.“ Then, each player discards all their cards with that cost.

cards.name: Electrical Charge
cards.abilities: Fight: Count how many [Ranged] Heroes you have. Draw that many cards.

cards.name: God of Cyborg Thunder
cards.abilities: Fight: You can spend [Recruit] as [Attack] this turn.

cards.name: Hammer Goliath

cards.name: Royal Treasury
cards.abilities: Fight: If King Hyperion is in the city, put him back on the Mastermind space and shuffle this Tactic back into his Tactics. If you do, you get +5[Recruit].

cards.name: Monarch of Utopolis
cards.abilities: Fight: If King Hyperion is in the city, put him back on the Mastermind space and shuffle this Tactic back into his Tactics. If you do, when you drew a new hand of cards at the end of this turn, draw three extra cards.

cards.name: Rule with an Iron Fist
cards.abilities: Fight: If King Hyperion is in the city, put him back on the Mastermind space and shuffle this Tactic back into his Tactics. If you do, you may defeat a Villain in the city for free.

cards.name: Shiklah, the Demon Bride
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Monster Metropolis
Master Strike: Reveal the top three cards of the Villain Deck. Put all the Scheme Twists you revealed on top of the Villain Deck. Put the rest on the bottom of that deck in random order.

cards.name: Shiklah's Husband, Deadpool
cards.abilities:
Fight: Gain this as a Hero.
 | 
You get +1[Attack] for each Hero with an odd-numbered cost you played this turn. (0 is even.)

cards.abilities: Fight: [Fateful Resurrection]. If she resurrects, rescue four bystanders.

cards.abilities: Fight: [Fateful Resurrection]. If she resurrects, defeat a Villain in the city for free.

cards.name: Infernal Power
cards.abilities: Fight: [Fateful Resurrection]. If she resurrects, draw two cards.

cards.name: Spider-Queen
cards.abilities:
Spider-Queen gets +1[Attack] for each Bystander in the Escape pile.
Always Leads: Spider-Infected
Master Strike: Each player puts a Spider-Infected from their Victory Pile into an empty city space. Any player who cannot do so gains a Wound.

cards.name: Sonic Scream
cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal the top eight cards of the Villain Deck. Put all the Bystanders you revealed into the Escape pile. Put the rest on the bottom of the Villain Deck in random orders.

cards.name: Infect the Entire City
cards.abilities: Fight: Put a Bystander from the Bystander Deck into the Escape Pile. Then, each Spider-Infected in the city captures a Bystander.

cards.name: Control Arachnid Genes
cards.abilities: Fight: You may gain a [Spider Friends] Hero from the HQ.

cards.name: Web the Skyscrapers
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Spider Friends] Hero or puts a Bystander from their Victory Pile into the Escape pile.

cards.name: Hybrid
cards.abilities:
If you fight Hybrid while he's bonded to a Villain, defeat that Villain and rescue three Bystanders instead of taking a Tactic.
Always Leads: Life Foundation
Master Strike: A Villain from the city [Symbiote Bonds] with Hybrid, If Hybrid was already bonded, then each player gains a Wound instead.

cards.name: Epic Hybrid
cards.abilities:
If you fight Hybrid while he's bonded to a Villain, defeat that Villain and rescue three Bystanders instead of taking a Tactic.
Always Leads: Life Foundation
Master Strike: The highest [Attack] unbonded Villain from the city and/or Escape Pile [Symbiote Bonds] with Hybrid. If no new bond could occur, then each player gains a Wound instead.

cards.name: Alien Awakening
cards.abilities: Fight: If this is not the final tactic, a Henchman Villain from any Victory Pile [Symbiote Bonds] with Hybrid.

cards.name: Escaped Monstrosity
cards.abilities: Fight: If this is not the final Tactic, a Villain from the city or Escape Pile [Symbiote Bonds] with Hybrid.

cards.name: Life Foundation Research
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +1[Recruit] for each Life Foundation Villain in your Victory Pile.

cards.name: Symbiotic Call
cards.abilities: Fight: If this is not the final Tactic, reveal the top four cards of the Villain Deck. A Henchman Villain you revealed [Symbiote Bonds] with Hybrid. Put the rest back in any order.

cards.name: Poison Thanos
cards.abilities:
Poison Thanos gets +1[Attack] for each different cost among cards in his “Poisoned Souls“ pile.
Always Leads: Poisons
Master Strike: Each player reveals their hand and puts one of their non-grey Heroes next to Thanos in a “Poisoned Souls“ pile.

cards.name: Epic Poison Thanos
cards.abilities:
Poison Thanos gets +2[Attack] for each different cost among cards in his “Poisoned Souls“ pile.
Always Leads: Poisons
Master Strike: Each player reveals their hand and puts half (round up) of their non-grey Heroes next to Thanos in a “Poisoned Souls“ pile. Each player that lost no Heroes this way gains a Wound.

cards.name: Desperate Rescue
cards.abilities: Fight: You may gain a Hero from Poison Thanos' “Poisoned Souls“ pile.

cards.name: Poisoned Loyalties
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player puts a Poisons card from their discard pile into Poison Thanos' “Poisoned Souls“ pile.

cards.name: Searing Poisons
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player discards a Poisons card from their hand or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Soul Seize
cards.abilities: Fight: Put all Heroes that cost 5 or more from the HQ into Poison Thanos' “Poisoned Souls“ pile.

cards.name: Dr. Strange
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Defenders
Command Strike: Reveal the top three cards of the Adversary Deck. Put the Adversary you revealed with the highest printed [Attack] on top of that deck. Then play a Plot Twist from among the cards you revealed. Then put the rest of those cards on the bottom of that deck in random order.

cards.name: Book of the Vishanti
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Covert] Ally or discards all the cards in their hand, then draws as many cards as they discarded.

cards.name: Crimson Bands of Cyttorak
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand, then gains a Bindings for each non-grey Ally that player has.

cards.name: Eye of Agamotto
cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal cards from the Ally Deck equal to the number of players. Put one of those cards into each player's discard pile.

cards.name: Winds of Watoomb
cards.abilities: Fight: After you draw a new hand of cards at the end of this turn, each player simultaneously passes a non-grey Ally from their hand to the hand of the player on their left.

cards.name: Nick Fury
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Avengers
Command Strike: Stack this Strike next to Nick Fury. Then [demolish] each player once for each Strike stacked here.

cards.name: Bounty on Fury's Head
cards.abilities: Fight: KO any number of your [HYDRA] Allies. For each Ally you KO'd this way, you may gain a Madame HYDRA.

cards.name: Purge Hydra
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards two [HYDRA] Allies.

cards.name: The Avengers Initiative
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Tech] Ally or chooses an Avengers Adversary from their Victory Pile and it enters the Bridge.

cards.name: Total Fury
cards.abilities: Fight: Defeat an Adversary whose [Attack] is less than the number of [HYDRA] Allies in the KO pile.

cards.name: Odin
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Asgardian Warriors
Odin gets +1[Attack] for each Asgardian Warrior in the city and in the Overrun Pile.
Command Strike: Each player puts an Asgardian Warrior from their Victory Pile into an empty city space. Any player who cannot do so gains a Bindings.

cards.name: Divine Justice
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player with a Bindings in their discard pile gains another Bindings.

cards.name: Might of Valhalla
cards.abilities: Fight: Draw a card for each Asgardian Warrior in your Victory Pile.

cards.name: Riches of Asgard
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +1[Recruit] for each Asgardian Warrior in your Victory Pile.

cards.name: Ride of the Valkyries
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Foes of Asgard] Ally or discards a card for each Asgardian Warrior in the Overrun Pile.

cards.name: Professor X
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: X-men First Class
Command Strike: Choose the two highest-cost Allies in the Lair. Stack them next to Professor X as “Telepathic Pawns.“ Professor X gets +1[Attack] for each Ally stacked next to him. Players can recrut the top Ally in the stack next to Professor X.

cards.name: Cerebro Device
cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal the top three cards of the Adversary Deck. Play any Adversaries you revealed that have “[X-Treme Attack]“. Put the rest back in random order.

cards.name: Mental Dominance
cards.abilities: Fight: Stack the top three cards of the Ally Deck next to Professor X in random order as “Telepathic Pawns.“

cards.name: Mightiest Mutant Mind
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Brotherhood] Ally or stacks a non-grey Ally from their hand next to Professor X as a “Telepathic Pawn.“

cards.name: Telepathic Imprisonment
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Brotherhood] Ally or gains a Bindings.

cards.name: Omega Red
cards.abilities:
Omega Red gets +2[Attack] while you have any Wounds and +2[Attack] while there are any Wounds in your discard pile.
When you KO any Wounds for the first time in a turn, put them on the bottom of the Wound Deck and gain a Wound to the bottom of your deck.
Always Leads: Any Villain Group
Master Strike: Each player discards one of their [Covert] Heroes or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Epic Omega Red
cards.abilities:
Omega Red gets +3[Attack] while you have any Wounds and +3[Attack] while there are any Wounds in your discard pile.
Whenever you KO any Wounds, put them on the bottom of the Wound Deck and gain a Wound to the bottom of your deck.
Always Leads: Any Villain Group
Master Strike: Each player KOs one of their [Covert] Heroes or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Carbonadium Tentacles
cards.abilities: Fight: After you draw a new hand of cards at the end of this turn, each player discards down to three cards or gains a Wound.

cards.name: The Carbonadium Synthesizer
cards.abilities: Fight: You may return a Wound from your hand or any player's discard pile to the bottom of the Wound Deck. If you do, draw a card.

cards.name: Death Pheromones
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player discards a [Tech] Hero or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Drain Life Force
cards.abilities: Fight: If this is not the final Tactic, and if you have at least two Wounds in your hand and/or discard pile, return all of them to the bottom of the Wound Deck and shuffle this Tactic back into Omega Red's other Tactics.

cards.name: Romulus
cards.abilities:
[Weapon X Sequence]
Always Leads: Weapon Plus
Master Strike: Each player reveals that they have a greater [Weapon X Sequence] than Romulus or gains a Wound. Then if this is the fifth Strike this game, this Strike becomes a Scheme Twist that takes effect immediately. (Once per game)

cards.name: Epic Romulus
cards.abilities:
[Doubled Weapon X Sequence]
Always Leads: Weapon Plus
Master Strike: Each player reveals that they have a greater [Weapon X Sequence] than Romulus (don't double his Sequence for this) or gains a Wound to the top of their deck. Then if this is the third Strike this game, this Strike becomes a Scheme Twist that takes effect immediately. (Once per game)

cards.name: Anoint an Heir to Take My Place
cards.abilities:
Fight: If this is not the last Tactic, a Hero from the HQ that costs 6 or more Ascends to become an additional Mastermind with [Attack] equal to its printed cost and only these abilities: “Fight: Choose a player to gain this as a Hero.
Master Strike: Each player discards a card of this Hero Class or gains a Wound.“

cards.name: Bite of the Muramasa Blade
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals three cards with different, adjacent costs (e.g. 2,3,4) or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Master of Schemes
cards.abilities: Fight: If this is not the last Tactic, reveal the top 2 cards of the Villain Deck. Play a Master Strike or Scheme Twist from among them, putting the rest back in any order.

cards.name: Take Over the Weapon X Program
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +[Recruit] equal to the [Attack] Romulus is gaining from [Weapon X Sequence].

cards.name: Sabretooth
cards.abilities:
Sabretooth [Berserks] once for each Savagery stacked here.
Always Leads: Berserkers
Master Strike: Stack this Strike next to Sabretooth as a “Savagery.“ Each player KOs one of their Heroes that costs more than the number of Savageries. Any player that cannot do so gains a Wound instead.
[Fail]: KO a non-grey Hero discarded by Sabretooth's Berserking.

cards.name: Epic Sabretooth
cards.abilities:
Sabretooth [Berserks] once for each Savagery stacked here, plus two more times.
Always Leads: Berserkers
Master Strike: Stack this Strike next to Sabretooth as a “Savagery.“ Each player KOs one of their Heroes that costs at least 2 more than the number of Savageries. Any player that cannot do so gains a Wound instead.
[Fail]: KO a non-grey Hero discarded by Sabretooth's Berserking.

cards.name: Adamantium-Laced Claws
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Instinct] Hero or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Lethal Fangs
cards.abilities: Fight: KO a grey Hero discarded by Sabretooth's Berserking. (You can't KO cards you shuffled into your deck during the Berserking.)

cards.name: Salivating Prowl
cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal the top three cards of your deck. Draw one of them, discard one, and put the other back on top of your deck.

cards.name: Sudden Savagery
cards.abilities: Fight: Stack a card from the Wound Deck next to Sabretooth as a “Savagery.“

cards.name: General “Thunderbolt” Ross
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Stack 8 Bystanders next to General Ross as “Helicopter“ Villains with 2[Attack]. You can fight them to rescue them as Bystanders. You can't fight General Ross while he has any Helicopters.
Always Leads: Code Red
Master Strike: General Ross [Transforms], then [Cross-Dimensional Hulk Rampage].

cards.name: Red Hulk
cards.abilities:
[Wounded Fury]
You can't fight Helicopters, and they don't stop you from fighting Red Hulk.
Master Strike: Red Hulk [Transforms], then stack a random Bystander from each player's Victory Pile next to this as a Helicopter. Each player who didn't have a Bystander gains a Wound instead.

cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player puts a non-grey Hero from their hand on the bottom of the Hero Deck, then puts a 0-cost Hero from the KO pile into their hand.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Call Out the Army
cards.abilities:
Fight: Put 3 Bystanders from the Bystander Stack next to this Mastermind as “Helicopters.“
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Personal Arsenal
cards.abilities:
Fight: For each Master Strike in the KO pile, put a Bystander from the Bystander Stack next to the Mastermind as a “Helicopter.“
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Urban Warfare
cards.abilities:
Fight: Put a random Bystander next to the Mastermind as a “Helicopter“ from each of these places: The Bystander Stack, the Escape Pile, each city space, and each other player's Victory Pile.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Illuminati, Secret Society
cards.abilities:
This Mastermind gets +4[Attack] unless you [Outwit] them.
Always Leads: Illuminati
Master Strike: Each player reveals their hand and discards two cards that each cost between 1 and 4. The Illuminati [Transform].

cards.name: Illuminati, Open Warfare
cards.abilities:
Whenever a card effect causes a player to draw any number of cards, that player must then also discard a card.
Master Strike: Each player reveals their hand and discards two cards that each cost between 5 and 8. The Illuminati [Transform].

cards.name: Black Bolt's Omni-Shout
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards two cards with no rules text.
The Illuminati [Transform].

cards.name: Dr. Strange's Orb of Agamotto
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards a [Ranged] or [Instinct] Hero.
The Illuminati [Transform].

cards.name: Hulkbuster's Hammer Fist
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and KOs a [Tech] or [Strength] Hero from their hand or discard pile.
The Illuminati [Transform].

cards.name: Zom's Manacles of Living Bondage
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals a [Covert] Hero or gains a Wound.
The Illuminati [Transform].

cards.name: King Hulk, Sakaarson
cards.abilities:
King Hulk gets +1[Attack] for each Warbound Villain in the city and in the Escape Pile.
Always Leads: Warbound
Master Strike: Each player KO's a Warbound Villain from their Victory Pile or gains a Wound. King Hulk [Transforms].

cards.name: King Hulk, Worldbreaker
cards.abilities:
[Wounded Fury]
Master Strike: Each player reveals their hand, then KO's a card from their hand or discard pile that has the same card name as a card in the HQ. King Hulk [Transforms].

cards.name: Fury of the Green Scar
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards a Hero that isn't grey and isn't [Strength].
King Hulk [Transforms].

cards.name: Oath of the Warbound
cards.abilities:
Fight: The Villain in the Escape Pile with the highest printed [Attack] enters the Sewers.
King Hulk [Transforms].

cards.name: Revenge from the Stars
cards.abilities:
Fight: After you put this in your Victory Pile, [Cross-Dimensional Hulk Rampage].
King Hulk [Transforms].

cards.name: Rule By the Strongest
cards.abilities:
Fight: You get +1[Recruit] for each of your [Strength] Heroes.
King Hulk [Transforms].

cards.name: M.O.D.O.K.
cards.abilities:
All cards' [Outwit] abilities require four different costs instead of three.
Always Leads: Intelligencia
Master Strike: Each player who can't [Outwit] M.O.D.O.K. gains a Wound, then M.O.D.O.K. [Transforms].

cards.name: M.O.D.O.K., Network Nightmare
cards.abilities:
You can only fight M.O.D.O.K. with [Recruit], not [Attack].
Master Strike: Each player who can't [Outwit] M.O.D.O.K. KO's a non-grey Hero from their discard pile. M.O.D.O.K. [Transforms].

cards.name: Brain Scramble
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player discards their hand, then draws as many cards as they discarded.
M.O.D.O.K. [Transforms].

cards.name: Designed Only For...K.O.ING
cards.abilities:
Fight: Reveal the top three cards of your deck. KO one of them, draw one, and discard one.
M.O.D.O.K. [Transforms].

cards.name: Don't Get a Big head About It
cards.abilities:
Fight: Draw a card for each Intelligencia Villain in your Victory Pile.
M.O.D.O.K. [Transforms].

cards.name: Redundancy Algorithim
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards two cards that hand the same cost.
M.O.D.O.K. [Transforms].

cards.name: The Red King
cards.abilities:
You can't fight the Red King while any Villains are in the city.
Always Leads: Sakaar Imperial Guard
Master Strike: The Red King [Transforms], then each player reveals a [Tech] card or gains a Wound.

cards.name: The Red King, Power Armored
cards.abilities: Master Strike: The Red King [Transforms], then play another card from the Villain Deck.

cards.name: Haughty Spite
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player without a Red King Tactic in their Victory Pile gains a Wound.
The Red King [Transforms].

cards.name: Royal Bodyguard
cards.abilities:
Fight: Reveal cards from the Villain Deck until you reveal a Sakaar Imperial Guard. If you find one, play it. Either way, shuffle all the other revealed cards back into the Villain Deck.
The Red King [Transforms].

cards.name: Treasury of Sakaar
cards.abilities:
Fight: You get +1[Recruit] for each Sakaar Imperial Guard and Red King Tactic in your Victory Pile, including this one.
The Red King [Transforms].

cards.name: Vast Armies of Sakaar
cards.abilities:
Fight: If this is not the final Tactic, reveal the top three cards of the Villain Deck. Play all the Villains you revealed. Put the rest back in random order.
The Red King [Transforms].

cards.name: The Sentry
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Shuffle 2 Wounds into each player's deck before drawing starting hands.
Always Leads: Aspects of the Void
Master Strike: The Sentry [Transforms], then [Cross-Dimensional Void Rampage].

cards.name: The Void
cards.abilities:
[Wounded Fury]
Master Strike: [Feast] on each player. If this feasts on a player's grey Hero, that player gains a Wound. The Void [Transforms].

cards.name: Pacifying Light
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discard two cards with [Recruit] icons.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Power of a Million Exploding Suns
cards.abilities:
Fight: Put all Heroes from the HQ on the bottom of the Hero Deck. Each other player reveals their hand and discards each card with the same card name as any of those cards.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Reflexive Teleportation
cards.abilities:
Fight: Choose one of your Heroes that costs 5 or less. When you draw a new hand of cards at the end of this turn, add that Hero to your hand as an extra card.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Repressed Darkness
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals a [Ranged] Hero or plays an Aspects of the Void Villain from their Victory Pile as if playing it from the Villain Deck.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Arcade
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Arcade captures 5 [Human Shields].
Always Leads: Murderworld
Master Strike: Arcade captures a random Bystander from each player's Victory Pile as a [Human Shield]. Each player who didn't have a Bystander gains a Wound instead.

cards.name: Epic Arcade
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Arcade captures 8 [Human Shields]. Play a random Horror.
Always Leads: Murderworld
Master Strike: Arcade captures two random Bystander from each player's Victory Pile as a [Human Shield]. Each player who didn't have two Bystanders gains a Wound instead.

cards.name: I Love a Parade!
cards.abilities: Fight: Arcade captures two [Human Shields]. Play an extra card from the Villain Deck next turn.

cards.name: I Need an Audience
cards.abilities: Fight: Arcade captures [Human Shields] equal to the number of Villains in the city.

cards.name: Roulette Wheel of Death
cards.abilities: Fight: Arcade captures a random Bystander as a [Human Shield] from each of these places: The Bystander Stack, the Escape Pile, each city space, and each other player's Victory Pile.

cards.name: Welcome to my Theme Park!
cards.abilities: Fight: Arcade and each Murderworld Villain in the city capture two [Human Shields].

cards.name: Dark Phoenix
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Hellfire Club
Master Strike: KO the top card of the Hero Deck and each card in the Hero Deck that shares a color with it. Shuffle the Hero Deck.
Dark Phoenix Wins: When the Hero Deck is empty.

cards.name: Epic Dark Phoenix
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Hellfire Club
Master Strike: KO the top card of the Hero Deck and each card in the Hero Deck that shares a color with it. Shuffle the Hero Deck. Then, each player plays a Hellfire Club card from their Victory Pile. Next, play a random Horror.
Dark Phoenix Wins: When the Hero Deck is empty.

cards.name: Burn the World to Ashes
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player discards each card from their hand that has the same name as any card in the KO pile.

cards.name: Consume an Entire Galaxy
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player chooses a card from their discard pile that costs 1 or more and KOs it.

cards.name: Fiery Reincarnation
cards.abilities: Fight: Gain a Hero from the KO pile that costs 7 or more.

cards.name: Worship Me as a God
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player gains two 0-cost cards from the KO pile.

cards.name: Deathbird
cards.abilities:
Deathbird gets +1[Attack] for each Shi'ar Villain in the city and Escape Pile.
Always Leads: Shi'ar Imperial Guard and a Shi'ar Henchmen Group.
Master Strike: If there are already any Shi'ar Villains in the city, each player gains a Wound. Then this strike enters the city as a “Shi'ar Battlecruiser“ [Token Card] Villain with 7[Attack] worth 5 [Victory Points].

cards.name: Epic Deathbird
cards.abilities:
Deathbird gets +2[Attack] for each Shi'ar Villain in the city and Escape Pile.
Always Leads: Shi'ar Imperial Guard and a Shi'ar Henchmen Group.
Master Strike: If there are already any Shi'ar Villains in the city, play a random Horror. Then this strike enters the city as a “Shi'ar Battleship“ [Token Card] Villain with 9[Attack] worth 6 [Victory Points].

cards.name: Shi'ar Elite Bodyguards
cards.abilities: Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. This Tactic enters the city as a Villain whose only ability is “Escape: Shuffle this card back into Deathbird's Mastermind Tactics as another Tactic.“

cards.name: Shi'ar Extermination Legion
cards.abilities: Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. This Tactic enters the city as a Villain whose only ability is “Escape: Each player discards two cards.“

cards.name: Shi'ar Hovertake Battalion
cards.abilities: Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. This Tactic enters the city as a Villain whose only ability is “Escape: Each player gains a Wound.“

cards.name: Shi'ar Master Spies
cards.abilities: Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. This Tactic enters the city as a Villain whose only ability is “Escape: This card becomes a Scheme Twist that takes effect immediately.“

cards.name: Mojo
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Mojo captures 3 [Human Shields].
All Bystanders in Victory Piles are worth 3 [Victory Points].
Always Leads: Mojoverse
Master Strike: Mojo captures a [Human Shield]. Each player reveals a [Tech] Hero or discards a card at random.

cards.name: Epic Mojo
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Mojo captures 6 [Human Shields]. Play a random Horror.
All Bystanders in Victory Piles are worth 4 [Victory Points].
Always Leads: Mojoverse
Master Strike: Mojo and each Mojoverse Villain capture a [Human Shield]. Each player reveals a [Tech] Hero or discards down to 4 cards.

cards.name: Billions of TV Viewers
cards.abilities: Fight: Each player reveals a [Tech] Hero or chooses a random Bystander from their Victory Pile. Mojo captures those Bystanders as [Human Shields].

cards.name: Brain-Melting TV Marathon
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player without a Mojo Tactic in their Victory Pile gains a Wound.

cards.name: Cross-Dimensional Marketing
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +1[Recruit] for each Bystander in your Victory Pile. Mojo captures a [Human Shield].

cards.name: Mojo Branding Opportunity
cards.abilities: Fight: Draw a card for each Mojoverse Villain in your Victory Pile. Mojo captures a [Human Shield].

cards.name: Onslaught
cards.abilities:
Each player's hand size is 1 less.
Always Leads: Dark Descendants
Master Strike: KO all Heroes [Dominated] by Onslaught. Then each player reveals their hand and chooses one of their non-grey Heroes. Onslaught [Dominates] those Heroes.

cards.name: Epic Onslaught
cards.abilities:
Each player's hand size is 1 less.
Always Leads: Dark Descendants
Master Strike: KO all Heroes [Dominated] by Onslaught. Then each player reveals their hand and chooses two of their non-grey Heroes. Onslaught [Dominates] those Heroes. Then play a random Horror.

cards.name: Godlike Psionic Entity
cards.abilities: Fight: Onslaught [Dominates] all five Heroes from the HQ.

cards.name: Sins of X-Men Past
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals the top six cards of their deck and chooses an [X-Men] Hero revealed this way. Onslaught [Dominates] those Heroes. Put the rest back in random order.

cards.name: Xavier and Magneto Combined
cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal the top three cards of the Hero Deck. Onslaught [Dominates] all the [X-Men] and [Brotherhood] Heroes you revealed. Put the rest back in random order.

cards.name: Worldwide Mental Control
cards.abilities: Fight: Onslaught [Dominates] four 0-cost Heroes from the KO pile. The next time a player fights Onslaught, KO those 0-cost Heroes.

cards.name: Shadow King
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Shadow-X
Master Strike: KO all Heroes [Dominated] by Shadow King. Then each player chooses a non-grey Hero from their discard pile. Shadow King [Dominates] those Heroes.

cards.name: Epic Shadow King
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Play two random Horrors.
Always Leads: Shadow-X
Master Strike: KO all Heroes [Dominated] by Shadow King. Then each player chooses two non-grey Hero from their discard pile. Shadow King [Dominates] those Heroes.

cards.name: Fiend of the Astral Plane
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and shuffles two cards with [Recruit] icons from their hand back into their deck.

cards.name: Poison their Minds
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and chooses one of their non-grey Heroes. Shadow King [Dominates] those Heroes.

cards.name: Psychic Seduction
cards.abilities: Fight: Shadow King [Dominates] each Hero that costs 5 or less from the HQ.

cards.name: Telepathic Betrayal
cards.abilities: Fight: If the “Betrayal of the Shadow“ Trap is in any Victory Pile or the KO pile, put it on top of the Villain Deck.
